nodes.description: Library function removeByIdx(uint256[] array,uint256 idx) that clones the array and shifts elements to drop the element at idx
Library function copy(uint256[] array,uint256 len) that allocates a new array and copies up to len elements
Library function getHash(uint256[] array) that folds the array into a single uint256 using base 100 powers
Library function contains(address[] adrs,address adr) returning whether adr is present in adrs
View function random(uint256 max,uint256 mixed) mixing blockhash, coinbase, difficulty, gaslimit, now/block.timestamp and tx.origin into a pseudo-random value
Pure function getIdxArray(uint256 len) returning the array [0..len-1] built with a uint128 loop counter
View function genRandomArray(uint256 digits,uint256 templateLen,uint256 base) that draws random indices and removes them from the index pool
Block timestamp / now used as an entropy source inside CommUtils.random
Original transaction sender used as an entropy source inside CommUtils.random
Chained unchecked additions/multiplications building hashVal in CommUtils.random (hashVal += 31*coinbase ... += 7*block.timestamp ... += 3*tx.origin)
Unchecked arithmetic ans = ans + uint256(array[i]*pow) and pow = pow*baseStep in ArrayUtils.getHash, both able to overflow
Unchecked loop index arithmetic (idx+1) and idx++ used while shifting the array in ArrayUtils.removeByIdx
